learning_outcomes.text: Students will gain the ability to prepare and present scientific research/design reports.
They will be able to conduct information research from various sources.
They will be able to write official correspondence, business letters, and CVs.
They will gain effective communication skills.
They will be able to work independently or as part of a team.

syllabus_topics: Source Research and Analysis of Sources
Use of Sources and Citation Styles
Business Letter and CV Preparation Techniques
Source Research and Analysis of Sources
Collection and Analysis of Information and Data
Presentation Planning, Writing and Delivery Techniques
Official Correspondence, Business Letters, CV Preparation
bibliography: Pugh, J.W., Sukan, F.V., “Technical and Formal Writing”, Ege Üniversitesi Basımevi, İzmir, 1994.
Cebeci, S. "Bilimsel Aratırma ve Yazma Teknikleri", Alfa Yayınları, 3. Basım, 2010.
Adair, J., "Etkili İletiçşim", Babıali Kültür Yayıcılığı, 3. Baskı, 2006.
